payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

fact.question: Is any visible part of the background recognizably basketball-court-related?
fact.present_when: A visible background feature is identifiable as part of a basketball court, such as a court playing surface, basketball-court marking, hoop, or backboard.
fact.absent_when: The assessable background shows no recognizable basketball-court-related feature.
fact.unknown_when: The relevant background is too obscured, cropped, or unclear to determine whether any such feature is present.

response.content: {"status":"present","evidence":"The edited background visibly includes a basketball hoop and backboard, along with basketballs and court markings."}
